package main

import (
 "crypto/sha256"
 "encoding/hex"
 "encoding/json"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "strings"

 "retrom/internal/capability/security/authn"
)

type policyCase struct {
 Name string
 PasswordHex string
 ConfirmationHex string
 Username string
 DisplayName string
 Blocklist string
 Entries map[string]bool
 Normalized string
 Error string
 Reason authn.PasswordReason
 IsPasswordInvalid bool
}
type memberCase struct { Query string; Contains bool }
type loadCase struct { Name string; Error string; IsBlocklistInvalid bool; IsNotExist bool; NonNil bool }
type golden struct {
 SourceRevision string
 SourceSHA256 map[string]string
 PayloadSHA256 string
 PayloadSize int
 Policy []policyCase
 Membership []memberCase
 Loads []loadCase
}
type oldMap map[string]bool
func (values oldMap) Contains(value string) bool { return values[value] }
func fail(err error) { if err != nil { panic(err) } }
func errText(err error) string { if err == nil { return "" }; return err.Error() }

func main() {
 repo, destination := os.Args[1], os.Args[2]
 root := filepath.Join(repo, "data")
 loaded, err := authn.LoadBlocklist(root)
 fail(err)
 payload, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "auth/password-blocklists/v1/payload/10k-most-common.txt"))
 fail(err)
 digest := sha256.Sum256(payload)
 result := golden{
  SourceRevision: "43b73ec928f6d88bfe041657c9884a6cf0f52e3f",
  SourceSHA256: map[string]string{},
  PayloadSHA256: hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), PayloadSize: len(payload),
 }
 for _, source := range []string{"internal/capability/security/authn/blocklist.go", "internal/capability/security/authn/password.go"} {
  body, readErr := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(repo, source)); fail(readErr)
  sum := sha256.Sum256(body); result.SourceSHA256[source] = hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
 }
 for _, query := range []string{"password", "PASSWORD", "123456", "Password", "retrom", "qwerty", "", " password", "password ", "not-a-common-retrom-password-927!"} {
  result.Membership = append(result.Membership, memberCase{Query: query, Contains: loaded.Contains(query)})
 }
 add := func(name, password, confirmation, username, display, kind string, entries oldMap) {
  var blocklist authn.Blocklist
  switch kind {
  case "empty": blocklist = authn.EmptyBlocklist{}
  case "public": blocklist = loaded
  case "custom": blocklist = entries
  }
  normalized, validationErr := authn.ValidatePassword(password, confirmation, username, display, blocklist)
  record := policyCase{
   Name:name, PasswordHex:hex.EncodeToString([]byte(password)), ConfirmationHex:hex.EncodeToString([]byte(confirmation)),
   Username:username, DisplayName:display, Blocklist:kind, Entries:entries, Normalized:normalized,
   Error:errText(validationErr), IsPasswordInvalid:errors.Is(validationErr,authn.ErrPasswordInvalid),
  }
  var policy *authn.PasswordError
  if errors.As(validationErr, &policy) { record.Reason = policy.Reason }
  result.Policy = append(result.Policy, record)
 }
 add("nil permits uncommon", "secure phrase 123", "secure phrase 123", "alice", "Alice", "nil", nil)
 add("empty permits common", "password", "password", "alice", "Alice", "empty", nil)
 add("loaded rejects common", "password", "password", "alice", "Alice", "public", nil)
 add("fold before membership", "PASSWORD", "PASSWORD", "alice", "Alice", "public", nil)
 add("exact membership permits suffix", "password!", "password!", "alice", "Alice", "custom", oldMap{"password":true})
 add("confirmation before common", "password", "different", "alice", "Alice", "public", nil)
 add("context before common username", "password", "password", "PASSWORD", "Alice", "public", nil)
 add("context before common display", "password", "password", "alice", "PASSWORD", "public", nil)
 add("reserved context before custom", "ReTrOm", "ReTrOm", "alice", "Alice", "custom", oldMap{"retrom":true})
 add("confirmation before context", "ReTrOm", "other!", "alice", "Alice", "custom", oldMap{"retrom":true})
 add("control before mismatch", "a\n", "other!", "alice", "Alice", "public", nil)
 add("short before mismatch", "short", "other!", "alice", "Alice", "public", nil)
 add("invalid utf8 before mismatch", string([]byte{0xff,'a','b','c','d','e'}), "other!", "alice", "Alice", "public", nil)
 add("long before mismatch", strings.Repeat("x",129), "other!", "alice", "Alice", "public", nil)
 add("NFC password and confirmation", "Cafe\u0301xy", "Caféxy", "alice", "Alice", "nil", nil)
 add("NFC folded membership", "CAFE\u0301XY", "CAFÉXY", "alice", "Alice", "custom", oldMap{"caféxy":true})
 add("full casefold membership", "Straße!", "Straße!", "alice", "Alice", "custom", oldMap{"strasse!":true})
 add("NFC before minimum length", "a\u0301bcde", "ábcde", "alice", "Alice", "nil", nil)
 add("six unicode accepted", "甲乙丙丁戊己", "甲乙丙丁戊己", "alice", "Alice", "nil", nil)
 add("maximum unicode bytes accepted", strings.Repeat("😀",128), strings.Repeat("😀",128), "alice", "Alice", "nil", nil)
 add("over maximum unicode rejected", strings.Repeat("😀",129), strings.Repeat("😀",129), "alice", "Alice", "nil", nil)
 add("control after overlength wins", strings.Repeat("x",129)+"\x00", "other!", "alice", "Alice", "nil", nil)
 add("invalid confirmation mismatches", "secure phrase", string([]byte{0xff}), "alice", "Alice", "public", nil)
 add("leading space is significant", " password", " password", "alice", "Alice", "custom", oldMap{"password":true})
 tempRoot, err := os.MkdirTemp(filepath.Dir(destination), "rf04-blocklist-old-load-"); fail(err)
 for _, name := range []string{"missing", "directory", "empty", "truncated", "oversized", "same-size-changed", "invalid-utf8", "valid"} {
  dependencyRoot := filepath.Join(tempRoot,name)
  target := filepath.Join(dependencyRoot,"auth/password-blocklists/v1/payload/10k-most-common.txt")
  if name != "missing" {
   fail(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target),0700))
   bytes := append([]byte{},payload...)
   switch name {
   case "directory": fail(os.Mkdir(target,0700))
   case "empty": bytes=[]byte{}
   case "truncated": bytes=bytes[:len(bytes)-1]
   case "oversized": bytes=append(bytes,'x')
   case "same-size-changed": bytes[0]^=1
   case "invalid-utf8": bytes[0]=0xff
   }
   if name!="directory" { fail(os.WriteFile(target,bytes,0600)) }
  }
  list, loadErr := authn.LoadBlocklist(dependencyRoot)
  result.Loads=append(result.Loads,loadCase{Name:name,Error:errText(loadErr),IsBlocklistInvalid:errors.Is(loadErr,authn.ErrBlocklistInvalid),IsNotExist:errors.Is(loadErr,os.ErrNotExist),NonNil:list!=nil})
 }
 encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(result,"","  "); fail(err)
 fail(os.WriteFile(destination,append(encoded,'\n'),0600))
 fmt.Printf("captured %d policy, %d membership, %d loading outcomes to %s\n",len(result.Policy),len(result.Membership),len(result.Loads),destination)
}
